title: 第13章 筹备
slug: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
lines: 雾气越来越浓。
陈峰握着工兵铲，贴着沿街建筑的外墙一步一步朝西侧摸过去。
前方的路面碎的不成样子，碎石和杂草交织在一起。
陈峰每踩一步都得小心翼翼，生怕弄出太大动静。
走大概六七十米，前方的浓雾中一个模糊的轮廓渐渐浮了出来，是一栋两层的小楼。
整栋小楼比周围的居民楼矮了一截，外墙刷过的白漆大片大片的剥落，露出底下灰扑扑的水泥。
陈峰放缓脚步，眯着眼透过护目镜往前看。
只见小楼的门口上方挂着一块横匾，匾额歪斜着只剩一头还挂在钉子上，另一头垂下来在微风中轻轻晃荡。
匾面上的字被风雨侵蚀的缺笔少划，但依稀还能辨认出几个字。
【刘氏武馆】
陈峰心跳微微加速。
找到了，日记里那个中学生提到的武馆就是这里。
他上前走了几步，伴随距离的接近，这栋小楼的轮廓更加清晰。
整栋小楼有两层高大门半掩着，门板上的木头已经朽烂了大半，门缝里透出一片漆黑。
随后，陈峰走到楼外七八米的地方，便停下脚步。
打量了几秒，并没有着急进去。
大墟世界这么危险，到处都是异种生物，谁知道这栋小楼里面有没有其他怪物？
陈峰琢磨了一下，
弯腰捡起地上一块拳头大的碎石，朝着武馆大门里面甩了进去。
碎石在半空中划过一道弧线，随后落在武馆内的地面上，弹了两下，又滚出去老远，发出一连串的动静。
陈峰竖起耳朵，仔细听了一会儿。
一秒、两秒、三秒……似乎没有动静。
他又捡起一块更大的石头，这次没往门里丢，而是砸在武馆外墙上。
石头砸在水泥墙面上炸开碎渣四溅，发出一声巨大的动静。
然而等了片刻，里面似乎还是没有传来异种生物的动静。
陈峰心中稍稍放松，但他还是有些不放心，
于是地上又摸了块碎石，这回用了七分力气直接朝门洞里扔了个高抛。
石头飞进去在黑暗中划了一道弧线。
武馆内骤然一静。
过了两秒。
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
陈峰在沙发上坐了一会儿，才再度站起身。

    他把防护服脱下来挂在阳台上晾着，换了身干净T恤，倒了杯凉白开灌了两口，然后拿起手机，打开浏览器。

    搜索栏里敲下三个字。

    “猎影蛛”。

    相关词条不少。

    猎影蛛属于织杀目中体型偏小的种类，但攻击性极强，野外遭遇的致死率排在蛛形纲异化体前五。

    陈峰往下翻。

    一篇武道论坛上的帖子引起了他的注意，发帖人是一个官方认证的异种生物研究员。

    帖子标题写着——《猎影蛛野外习性探究》。

    帖子有点长，陈峰一条一条看下去。

    “……猎影蛛视觉退化严重，主要依靠足部震动感知和空气振动来定位猎物……”

    “……猎影蛛对磷化铝类气体高度敏感，此类气体会严重干扰其呼吸系统，导致其行动能力大幅下降……”

    “……织杀目蛛类的腹部甲壳覆盖率普遍较低，腹部是其最大的防御弱点……”

    “……猎影蛛对血腥气味有明显的趋近反应……”

    陈峰稍微梳理了一下。

    视觉差，靠震动感知。

    怕磷化铝。

    腹部防御薄弱。

    不会离巢太远，对血腥气味有趋近反应。

    他退出帖子，又搜了“磷化铝”。

    这东西本身是一种农用熏蒸剂，民用渠道买不到纯品。

    但白鱼APP上有一种叫“灭巢烟弹”的商品，主要成分就是磷化铝的衍生物，专门用来对付中小型蛛类异化生物。

    一枚两千块，使用方式很简单，拔掉保险销，投掷进封闭空间，十秒后释放大量毒烟。

    陈峰又翻了翻评论区。

    有人说这东西对猎影蛛的效果亲测有效，但不致死，只能让它短时间内行动迟缓，大概持续三到五分钟。

    三到五分钟，也算可以了。

    他继续往下翻，又看到了另一个让他感兴趣的东西。

    粘网陷阱。

    这是一种专门针对中型异种生物的约束型陷阱，展开后是一张三米见方的高强度粘性网。

    触发方式分为压力触发和手动触发两种。

    粘网的材质是用异化蛛丝和工业粘合剂混合制成的，粘性极强。

    一旦被缠上，实力在淬体中期以下的异种生物基本挣脱不开。

    一张网三千块钱。

    陈峰在心里盘算了一下。

    一枚灭巢烟弹，两千块，两张粘网陷阱，三千块。

    而备用的防毒面罩滤芯、诱饵剂这些零碎，差不多也要两千块钱。

    一共就是一万块钱。

    “啧，好贵……”

    陈峰这时突然想起什么，立刻打开白鱼APP，切换到卖家后台。

    订单状态全部显示“已签收”。

    十九株灰伞肺菇，单价一千，总计一万九千。

    扣除平台百分之一的手续费，实际到账一万八千八百一十块。

    他顿时松了口气，有钱了。

    “下单！”

    一万块钱瞬间清空。

    做完这些，陈峰把手机丢到一边，正准备起身。

    余光扫到茶几旁边靠墙放着的工兵铲。

    铲刃已经卷了。

    连砍五只铁鄂灰蜚，刃口肉眼可见地翻卷变形，再用下去，砍铁鄂灰蜚的甲壳都费劲，更别说对付猎影蛛了。

    而且工兵铲本来就不是正经兵器。

    钢材普通，刃口薄，拿来挖土还行，拿来砍虫子属实是难为它了。
content_en:
Chen Feng sat on the sofa for a while before standing up again.

He took off his protective clothing and hung it on the balcony to dry, put on a clean T-shirt, poured a glass of cold water and took two sips, then picked up his phone and opened the browser.

Type three words in the search bar.

"Shadowhunting Spider".

There are many related entries.

The shadow hunter spider is a small species in the order Weavers, but it is extremely aggressive. The fatality rate encountered in the wild ranks among the top five arachnids.

Chen Feng scrolled down.

A post on a martial arts forum caught his attention. The poster was an officially certified xenobiotic researcher.

The title of the post reads - "Inquiry into the Wild Habits of Shadow Hunter Spiders".

The post is a bit long, so Chen Feng reads it one by one.

"...The shadow hunter spider's vision is severely degraded, and it mainly relies on foot vibration sensing and air vibration to locate prey..."

"...The shadow hunter spider is highly sensitive to aluminum phosphide gases. Such gases will seriously interfere with its respiratory system, causing its ability to move to be significantly reduced..."

"...The abdominal carapace coverage of weavers is generally low, and the abdomen is its biggest defensive weakness..."

"...The Shadow Hunter Spider has an obvious approach response to the smell of blood..."

Chen Feng sorted it out a little.

Poor vision, relies on vibration perception.

Afraid of aluminum phosphide.

Abdominal defenses are weak.

It will not stray too far from its nest and has an approach response to the smell of blood.

He exited the post and searched for "aluminum phosphide".

This thing itself is an agricultural fumigant, and the pure product cannot be purchased through civilian channels.

However, there is a product called "nest-killing smoke bomb" on the Baiyu APP. The main ingredient is a derivative of aluminum phosphide, which is specially used to deal with small and medium-sized spider alien creatures.

It costs two thousand yuan each. The method of use is very simple. Pull out the safety pin and throw it into a closed space. After ten seconds, a large amount of poisonous smoke will be released.

Chen Feng scrolled through the comment area again.

Some people say that this thing is effective against the Shadow Hunter Spider in personal tests, but it does not kill it. It can only make it slow down for a short period of time, which lasts about three to five minutes.

Three to five minutes is fine.

He continued to scroll down and saw another thing that interested him.

Sticky web trap.

This is a restraint trap designed specifically for medium-sized alien creatures. When unfolded, it becomes a three-meter-square high-strength sticky net.

There are two triggering methods: pressure triggering and manual triggering.

The material of the sticky web is made of a mixture of alienated spider silk and industrial adhesive, which is extremely sticky.

Once entangled, alien creatures with strength below the mid-stage tempering stage are basically unable to break away.

A net costs three thousand yuan.

Chen Feng thought about it in his mind.

One nest-killing smoke bomb costs 2,000 yuan, and two sticky web traps cost 3,000 yuan.

Spare gas mask filters, baits and other bits and pieces cost almost 2,000 yuan.

The total is ten thousand yuan.

"Tsk, so expensive..."

Chen Feng suddenly remembered something and immediately opened the Baiyu APP and switched to the seller's backend.

The order status all shows "Received".

Nineteen P. cinerea mushrooms cost 1,000 each, totaling 19,000.

After deducting the platform's 1% handling fee, the actual amount received was 18,810 yuan.

He immediately breathed a sigh of relief, he had money.

"Place your order!"

Ten thousand yuan was wiped out instantly.

After doing this, Chen Feng threw his phone aside and was about to get up.

Out of the corner of his eye, he spotted the engineering shovel placed against the wall next to the coffee table.

The blade has been rolled.

After cutting down five Iron-jawed Gray Flies in a row, the blade turned and deformed visibly. If he continued to use it, it would be difficult to cut through the Iron-jawed Gray Flies' carapace, let alone deal with the Shadow Hunter Spider.

Moreover, the engineer shovel is not a serious weapon in the first place.

The steel material is ordinary and the blade is thin. It can be used for digging in the soil, but it is really difficult to use it to chop insects.
